	setflag FLAG_RANGER_PARK_INTRO_SEEN

	goto_if_not_defeated TRAINER_RANGER_CAMP_1, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerParkLocked

	goto_if_not_defeated TRAINER_RANGER_CAMP_4, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerParkLocked
	msgbox SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkChallenge, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerParkNo
	trainerbattle_double TRAINER_RANGER_PARK, SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkYes, SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkDefeat, SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_NeedTwo, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerParkWon

SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerGift::
	goto_if_set FLAG_RANGER_CAMP_GIFT_RECEIVED, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerGiftTaken
	goto_if_not_defeated TRAINER_RANGER_PARK, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerGiftLocked
	bufferspeciesname STR_VAR_1, VAR_0x8005
	showmonpic VAR_0x8005, 10, 3
	msgbox SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_GiftPrompt, MSGBOX_YESNO
	hidemonpic
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerEndGift
	specialvar VAR_RESULT, RangerGiveGift
	goto_if_ne VAR_RESULT, MON_GIVEN_TO_PARTY, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerGiftFull
	removeobject 6
	removeobject 7
	removeobject 8
	playfanfare MUS_LEVEL_UP
	message SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_GiftReceived
	waitmessage
	waitfanfare
	msgbox Text_GiveNicknameToThisMon, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, SaffronCity_Dojo_RangerEndGift
	call EventScript_GetGiftMonPartySlot
	call EventScript_ChangePokemonNickname

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger1Intro::
    .string "We're Pokémon Rangers! When Trainers\n"
    .string "get stranded in the wild, we're the\l"
    .string "ones who find them!\p"
    .string "Let's see how well you handle a\n"
    .string "rescue team!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger1Defeat::
    .string "You've got some good instincts!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger1After::
    .string "Arcanine can track a missing Trainer\n"
    .string "by scent, even through rough\l"
    .string "terrain. It's one of our most\l"
    .string "dependable rescue Pokémon!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger2Intro::
    .string "Our Flying Pokémon patrol the skies,\n"
    .string "looking for Trainers who need help.\p"
    .string "Think you can handle an aerial\n"
    .string "rescue team?$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger2Defeat::
    .string "You spotted every opening!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger2After::
    .string "Fearow covers enormous distances\n"
    .string "during the day. Noctowl takes over\l"
    .string "at night.\p"
    .string "Someone's always watching out for\n"
    .string "Trainers!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger3Intro::
    .string "Rivers, lakes, oceans... Trainers can\n"
    .string "get into trouble anywhere!\p"
    .string "Our Pokémon train to handle even\n"
    .string "the toughest rescues!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger3Defeat::
    .string "You're a strong Trainer!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger3After::
    .string "Golduck is an incredible swimmer. It\n"
    .string "can reach stranded Trainers before\l"
    .string "anyone else.\p"
    .string "Manectric helps us search along the\n"
    .string "shoreline!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger4Intro::
    .string "Rangers have been protecting\n"
    .string "Trainers for generations!\p"
    .string "We've earned our reputation by going\n"
    .string "where others can't. Show me what\l"
    .string "you've got!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger4Defeat::
    .string "You've earned my respect!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_Ranger4After::
    .string "Caves, mountains, storms... No\n"
    .string "matter where a Trainer falls, we do\l"
    .string "our best to bring them home.\p"
    .string "That's what being a Ranger means!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkLore::
    .string "Welcome to the Pokémon Ranger\n"
    .string "Headquarters!\p"
    .string "I'm Ranger Park. I've spent many\n"
    .string "years helping Trainers across Kanto.\p"
    .string "You know, when a Trainer blacks out\n"
    .string "in the wild, they don't just wake up\l"
    .string "at a Pokémon Center by magic!\p"
    .string "That's our job! We find them, get\n"
    .string "them to safety, and make sure their\l"
    .string "Pokémon receive treatment.\p"
    .string "We do charge a rescue fee, but we\n"
    .string "work on a sliding scale. Usually,\l"
    .string "it's about half the money a Trainer\l"
    .string "has on hand.\p"
    .string "Nobody gets left behind just\n"
    .string "because they're short on cash!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkChallenge::
    .string "Now, I've heard some impressive\n"
    .string "things about your journey.\p"
    .string "You've got the makings of a fine\n"
    .string "Ranger yourself!\p"
    .string "How about a battle? Show me what\n"
    .string "you've learned!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkLocked::
    .string "You've got potential, but I'd like\n"
    .string "you to train with my four Rangers\l"
    .string "first. Come back after you've\l"
    .string "defeated them all!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkDefeat::
    .string "Outstanding! You've got the courage\n"
    .string "and judgment of a true Ranger!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkBeforeGift::
    .string "That was an impressive battle!\p"
    .string "You've got a real talent for working\n"
    .string "with Pokémon.\p"
    .string "I think you'd make a fine Ranger\n"
    .string "someday!\p"
    .string "Take a look behind me. Those three\n"
    .string "Poké Balls contain Pokémon we've\l"
    .string "trained for rescue work.\p"
    .string "I'd like you to take one along on\n"
    .string "your journey. Consider it a gift\l"
    .string "from all of us!$"

SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ParkAfterGift::
    .string "Excellent choice! That Pokémon has\n"
    .string "helped us through countless rescue\l"
    .string "exercises.\p"
    .string "Take good care of it, and it'll take\n"
    .string "good care of you!\p"
    .string "Remember, a Ranger's greatest\n"
    .string "strength isn't power. It's knowing\l"
    .string "when someone needs help!$"
